features.title: Compact Writing Surface
features.text: A lightweight, easy-to-mount whiteboard designed to keep your daily notes and ideas within sight — perfect for home studies and compact office spaces.

features.title: Smooth Erase Finish
features.text: Sized at 600×600 mm, it provides the perfect area for jotting down notes, reminders, or quick ideas without taking up excess wall space.

features.title: Neat and Easy to Mount
features.text: The high-quality dry-erase surface allows effortless writing and clean wiping, maintaining a clear, mark-free appearance.

features.title: Perfect for Compact Spaces
features.text: Equipped with mounting brackets, it can be easily hung on standard nails or hooks — ideal for flexible use in homes or offices.

features.title: Minimal and Functional Design
features.text: A space-efficient solution for home studies, small offices, or work pods, bringing structure and focus to daily tasks.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
